name: Cakes
overview: Scripture reveals that cakes, often unleavened and prepared with fine flour and oil, held a significant role in both daily life and sacred worship. Abraham's prompt preparation of cakes for guests (Genesis 18:6) illustrates their place in hospitality, while the detailed instructions in Exodus and Leviticus emphasize their use in offerings and thanksgiving sacrifices (Exodus 29:2; Leviticus 2:4; 7:12). The baking and presentation of cakes before the LORD (Leviticus 8:26; 24:5) further underscore their importance as part of the covenantal worship practices ordained by God.
